title: Mantoux test as a named skin assay
dek: Intradermal PPD, millimetres of induration. Wikipedia's method card. Cut-points, boosting, and IGRA comparison stay on tb-igra-tst.
story: The Mantoux test on Wikipedia is a method: purified protein derivative intradermally, read as millimetres of induration at 48–72 h. Charles Mantoux's name replaced older scratch tests in most programmes.
What the encyclopedia will not settle is the cut-point table (HIV, contacts, BCG policy) or two-step boosting. That is tb-igra-tst plus WHO TPT.
PPD is a mixture of antigens shared with BCG and many NTM. That single biochemical fact is why IGRAs exist as a neighbouring node.
deep: Erythema is not induration. Measure the bump, not the red.
TBSTs (antigen-based skin tests) are a newer WHO class; they are not classic PPD Mantoux.
A positive Mantoux does not diagnose a cavity. A negative one does not exclude TBM.
Do not dose TPT from this method card.
